fato_historico: 2013: At least 360 migrants are killed when their boat sinks near the Italian island of Lampedusa.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a wave of profound empathy as the tides pull you toward a sea of collective healing. Consider how your gentle heart can offer comfort to those in need, remembering that every soul deserves sanctuary. It is a good time to release past sorrows and envision a future where kindness serves as the ultimate beacon for all travelers.
frase_do_dia: A kind heart is a guiding light through the stormiest seas of life.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual intuition and the harmony of universal connections.
conselho: Offer your support to someone navigating a challenging current in their life today.
